UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Top-level non-PII user account anchor document for VyaparMitra shopkeepers.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

onboarded.description: Whether the shopkeeper has completed onboarding.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

ShopProfile.title: ShopProfile
ShopProfile.description: Private shopkeeper profile isolated under users/{uid}/profile/main containing shop name and optional PII.

phone.description: Optional verified or entered mobile phone number.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: Individual Kirana sale, expense, credit (udhaar), or payment (jama) entry stored in integer paise and ISO timestamps.

customerName.description: Customer, supplier, or category display name.

customerPhone.description: Optional customer phone number for wa.me link.

type.description: sale = daily sales, expense = shop expense, udhaar = credit given, jama = payment received.

amountPaise.description: Positive integer amount in paise (1 INR = 100 paise), or null only for expense entries awaiting amount entry.

note.description: Optional item list, receipt summary, or note.

source.description: How the entry was captured. Non-manual entries must begin as status=pending.

status.description: AI/voice/camera entries start as pending and become confirmed only upon explicit shopkeeper confirmation.

occurredAtIso.description: ISO 8601 date-time string for the transaction.

confidence.description: Optional AI/voice extraction confidence score between 0 and 1.

uncertainFields.description: Optional list of low-confidence fields requiring explicit user verification.

sourceImageUrl.description: Optional HTTPS link to the source register/bill photo in Firebase Storage.

confirmedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recorded when the shopkeeper explicitly confirmed the entry.

editedFields.description: Audit trail list of fields modified by the shopkeeper prior to confirmation.

originalAIValue.description: Immutable audit snapshot of original AI-extracted fields before shopkeeper confirmation.

amountPaise.description: Original AI integer paise amount, or null if missing/illegible.

/users/{uid}.description: Parent user account anchor document for each VyaparMitra shopkeeper.

/users/{uid}/profile/{profileId}.description: Shopkeeper onboarding profile (document ID 'main') with shopName, language, onboarded flag, and optional PII.

/users/{uid}/entries/{entryId}.description: Shopkeeper's private Kirana sales, expenses, credit, and payment entries stored in integer paise.
